summary: A baggage tractor reversed into the cargo door area of an aircraft and dented it.
A loader felt something go in his lower back lifting a heavy bag and was taken to the medical room.
A cleaner slipped on a wet patch and hit her elbow, then carried on after a rest.
A few litres of fuel dripped from a hose coupling during refuelling and were contained.
A forklift came round a corner fast and nearly hit a loader.
A belt loader stopped during unloading and had to be towed away.
Engines were powered up early and the blast knocked over carts and pushed a ramp agent off balance.
A bus driver noticed a burning smell from the engine bay and everyone got off normally.
Someone nearly fell near the aircraft steps but the report gives no detail.
A ramp agent hurt his hand and saw the first aider, with no other detail.
The report says both that a tug hit a wing tip and that it never touched the aircraft.
A cart tipped over and nobody was injured.
A baggage cart rolled into a parked aircraft.
A tug backed into an aircraft engine cowl, leaving a small dent, and the aircraft was held for a check.
A ramp agent tripped over a strap, badly hurt his wrist and was taken away by ambulance.
A loader felt a mild ache in his shoulder after lifting a small bag and asked for it to be logged.
A fuel truck hose burst and about 200 litres ran across a road toward a drain.
A baggage tractor crossed in front of a taxiing aircraft, which had to brake hard.
A ceiling panel fell onto a table in an empty break room after rain came through the roof.
